title: Essential smallness of native constructible sheaves
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and $X$ a Noetherian scheme. In the native internal-module category of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], the property of adic constructible sheaves is essentially small in the site/coefficient universe of [def-weil-size-convention]. Explicitly, there is a family indexed by a type in that universe such that every sheaf which is locally stratified lisse is isomorphic to a member of the family. No derived objects or realization functor are involved.

source.place: Native realization proof step 8, first sentence: count constructible cohomology sheaves, before any Postnikov argument.

proof.text: The normalized native encoding NativeEncoding.encoding l X (forget the restricted constant-field action and restrict scalars along the canonical coefficient isomorphism) is an equivalence onto module objects over the condensed algebraic-closure ring object R_X, hence full and faithful.

On the Noetherian scheme X, encoding_constructible_iff says that a native module is constructible exactly when its encoding is a constructible R_X-module object. Hence the encoding restricts to a full and faithful functor from the full subcategory of native constructible modules to that of constructible R_X-module objects. The empty scheme and zero ranks are included in that statement.

The constructible R_X-module objects are essentially small in universe u+1 by constructibleModuleObjects_essentiallySmall. A full and faithful functor into an essentially small category has essentially small source (essentiallySmall_of_fully_faithful), and the essential image of the full-subcategory inclusion contains every native constructible module, so the native property is essentially small in u+1. No derived objects are used.

proof_origin.place: Definitions 6.8.3 and 6.8.8; heart portion of step 8 of the native realization proof, proved in Lean by the reviewer of K3 12433ab5 through the native encoding and the constructible-module counting theorem (as in the G6 38c53fae review).
